description: Batch identity check of a French customer or CRM file: 2 to 150 lines per call, each a SIREN, SIRET, French VAT number or name|postcode, in file order. Use when a user hands over a customer export, e.g. « Voici mon export clients, complète et corrige SIREN, SIRET et TVA. » or « Enrichis et nettoie ma base CRM : SIREN, TVA, adresse, cessés et doublons. » Per line: resolution (resolu, a_confirmer with up to 5 candidates ranked by score_confiance, introuvable, siren_invalide, siren_inconnu, non_diffusible), SIREN, head-office SIRET, status and cessation date, address, VAT number checked live on VIES (indisponible, never a false invalide), duplicates flagged (doublon_de). VAT checks: in French business hours, VIES serves one verdict every 4 to 5 s and refuses concurrency; before pipelined checks, a full batch had 15 of 262 resolved lines checked; with them, outside business hours (23:51 UTC), 105 of 265; measured 2026-10-08; a line whose check could not start in time says non_verifie, budget_vies_epuise. Never a silent choice: a name is resolved only by a single candidate of the complete index union at its postcode that bears that name (legal name, usual name or acronym), otherwise a_confirmer; natural persons are never served as candidates (counted in candidats_non_servis). With ambiguous names, send 50 lines per call (each a_confirmer line carries its candidates). Request line up to 11000 bytes: about 148 names of 63 characters. With depuis (a past day or today), at most 20 lines per call: each resolu line also carries changements, what changed since that date in BODACC and the local stocks (verdict nouveautes, rien_de_nouveau or lecture_incomplete, totals per type, the 3 latest facts, the window actually read, lecture_complete and the line's blocks not read; stocks stale for that date are named once at the top, in changements.stocks_perimes); any other line says why in motif_sans_changements; billed $0.01 per line. EU tenders and industrial property: get_french_company_updates_since, one company per call. Billed per line at $0.003 via x402, duplicates included; with a verified account's API key (api_key), 100 lines a month are free, and a call of more lines than are left is paid in full. Closed lists: GET /v1/lecture. A full call of this tool costs at most $0.45 (150 lines), $0.20 with depuis (20 lines), within the $1.00 single-payment cap that x402 clients apply by default. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

depuis.description: Optional: also each resolved line's changes since this day, a past day or today, at $0.01 per line and 20 lines per call at most. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (a real date), or a full ISO 8601 timestamp (offset Z, ±HH:MM, ±HHMM or none, read as UTC): only its UTC day is kept.

lignes.description: 2 to 150 lines (20 with depuis), each a SIREN, a SIRET, a French VAT number (FR + 11 digits) or name|postcode (e.g. "HERMES INTERNATIONAL|75008")

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
